title: Reportes: vista del dueño y vista del encargado
brief: Rebuild Reportes as two role-specific dashboards with charts: three owner directions (whole business, 4 warehouses) and two manager directions (one warehouse). Replaces tabbed tables and the separate /direccion console.

artboards.title: A · Dueño: KPI, gráfica principal y desglose
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar and quick to read (KPI cards with sparklines, one hero chart, ventas-to-utilidad breakdown); the most complete in charts but long, and the insight is left to the reader.

artboards.title: B · Dueño: resumen en palabras
artboards.tradeoff: Each number comes with a plain sentence and a supporting chart, so the owner knows what to do; less scannable for comparing exact figures and wording must be generated from data.

artboards.title: C · Dueño: cuadrícula de comparación
artboards.tradeoff: Dense, accountant-like grid with warehouses as columns and everything side by side; the best for comparing, but heavier to read and with fewer charts.

artboards.title: D · Encargado: operación del día
artboards.tradeoff: Alerts first (stock, caducidades, caja, pedidos) and a week view; strong for daily action, sales trend and top products sit lower.

artboards.title: E · Encargado: ventas primero (con selector)
artboards.tradeoff: Sales chart, totals and product table lead, with the warehouse selector for a manager covering two warehouses and an explicit empty state; alerts are compact links, so urgency is lower.
